targets.Description: Veteran human rights campaigner and former Welsh Labour MP Ann Clwyd turned down an invitation to the coronation because she had been unwell and believed the restrictions placed on guests would be too gruelling for her. Ms Clwyd, now 86, represented Aberdare and then Cynon Valley from 1984 until 2019. A former Shadow Secretary of State for Wales, she was Tony Blair’s special envoy on human rights in Iraq. In 2004 she was made a member of the Privy Council, and she was one of a small number of Privy Councillors to receive an invitation to the coronation.
targets.Title of Target: Former Welsh MP turns down coronation invitation

targets.Description: A town’s coronation party had to be cancelled after organisers failed to raise any money to cover costs, claiming there was a “lack of interest”. Caldicot, in south-east Wales, was due to host a celebration in the town centre complete with big screen and children’s entertainment, but with just over a week to go the event was axed. Despite a crowdfunding appeal and an appeal to Monmouthshire County Council to help raise funds for the event, which would be in the region of between £2,500-£3,000, no money was forthcoming so the event had to be cancelled.
targets.Title of Target: Welsh town’s coronation party axed after organisers fail to raise ‘any money whatsoever’

targets.Title of Target: Republican protesters arrested in London ahead of coronation

targets.Description: More than a century after church and state were separated in Wales, some are questioning why the Church in Wales is playing a significant role in King Charles’ coronation. Though the Church in Wales has no representatives in Parliament the Archbishop of Wales, Andrew John, will be taking part in the coronation. The Cross of Wales, a new processional cross presented by King Charles as a centenary gift to the Church in Wales, will lead the coronation procession at Westminster Abbey. In what is seen as a significant ecumenical gesture, the Cross of Wales incorporates a relic of the True Cross, the personal gift of Pope Francis to the King to mark the coronation.
targets.Title of Target: Church in Wales’ roles in coronation questioned
